items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: ECC
items.summary: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
items.summary_en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

items.name: book-to-skill
items.summary: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍的PDF自动转化为Claude Code技能，解决开发者需要手动提取和整理知识以供编码时参考的痛点。其核心技术是利用大语言模型解析PDF，自动提取关键概念、示例和工作流程，并结构化生成可直接使用的技能文件。操作上，你只需提供一本技术书籍的PDF（如Python或机器学习教材），即可获得一个上下文感知的技能，让Claude Code在你编码时直接调用，从而加速学习、减少上下文切换。这个工具特别适合希望将书本知识快速转化为编程实践辅助的开发者。
items.summary_en: book-to-skill automatically converts technical book PDFs into Claude Code skills, solving the problem of manually extracting and organizing knowledge for on-the-job reference. Its technical core uses LLM-based parsing to extract key concepts, examples, and workflows from PDFs, structuring them into actionable skill files. Practically, you can feed any technical PDF—like a Python or ML textbook—and instantly get a context-aware skill that Claude Code can use while you code, accelerating learning and reducing context switching.

items.name: awesome-systematic-trading
items.summary: Awesome Systematic Trading 是一个系统化交易资源合集，为量化交易者、开发者和研究人员提供一站式学习与工具索引。项目按类别收录数据获取、策略库、回测框架及执行引擎等完整资源，并涵盖经典书籍、专业博客与教程。其高度组织化的结构帮助新手快速构建知识体系，进阶用户可精准定位套利机器人或alpha策略等专业工具。适合用作学习路线图或个人交易系统的搭建起点，通过筛选组合开源库高效实现策略构思到实盘验证。
items.summary_en: Awesome Systematic Trading is a curated hub for systematic trading resources, aggregating top libraries, strategies, books, blogs, and tutorials. Its strength lies in comprehensive yet organized coverage, enabling traders and developers to quickly find high-quality tools for backtesting, execution, and research. Users can treat it as a roadmap to explore algorithmic trading, discover new methodologies like arbitrage bots or alpha strategies, and accelerate their learning or project development from a single, vetted source.

items.name: speech-to-speech
items.summary: 这个由Hugging Face推出的开源项目，让你用本地模型构建语音到语音的智能体，完美解决隐私和延迟痛点。其核心是模块化流水线：将Whisper（语音转文字）、Coqui TTS（文字转语音）和翻译模型无缝衔接，所有处理离线运行。你可以快速创建完全离线的语音助手、实时翻译器或无障碍工具，甚至可以替换任何组件。社区活跃，文档完善，适合隐私敏感或低延迟场景。
items.summary_en: speech-to-speech is a Hugging Face framework for building local voice agents with open-source models, addressing privacy and latency concerns. Its key insight is a modular pipeline that combines ASR (e.g., Whisper), TTS (e.g., Coqui), and optional translation, all running offline. You can rapidly prototype privacy-first voice assistants, real-time translators, or accessibility tools without cloud dependencies, and swap components freely. Fully open under Apache-2.0.

items.name: GeoLibre
items.summary: GeoLibre 是一款轻量级、云原生的 GIS 平台，旨在让地理空间数据的可视化和分析在任何设备上无缝运行——浏览器、桌面、移动端乃至 Jupyter Notebook 中。它巧妙融合 DuckDB 的高效 SQL 地理查询、MapLibre GL JS 的交互式渲染与 Tauri 的桌面原生性能，无需厚重软件栈即可加载和查询海量 GeoJSON、Shapefile 或 PostGIS 数据。您可通过 npm 或 Docker 快速部署，在 Jupyter 中集成用于可复现的研究，或作为独立应用直接使用。其核心理念是让地理分析轻量化、随处可用，真正降低空间数据探索的门槛。
items.summary_en: GeoLibre is a lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform that brings geospatial data visualization and analysis to browsers, desktops, mobile devices, and Jupyter notebooks, solving cross-platform spatial exploration challenges. It combines DuckDB's SQL-based geospatial query engine, MapLibre GL JS for interactive rendering, and Tauri for native desktop performance, enabling efficient processing of large datasets without heavy dependencies. You can install via npm or Docker, embed it into Jupyter for reproducible workflows, or run it standalone for quick exploration of GeoJSON, Shapefile, or PostGIS data—making geospatial analysis truly portable and accessible.

items.name: free-stockdb
items.summary: free-stockdb 是一个面向 A 股日K、分钟K与ETF分钟数据的本地量化引擎，核心解决云端数据依赖带来的延迟与隐私问题。它通过增量同步机制自动更新本地SQLite数据库，支持复权、批量查询、回测与指标计算，所有操作在本地完成，速度极快且可离线使用。其设计理念是“把数据主权还给用户”，特别适合量化研究员和算法交易者进行快速回测与策略验证。你可以直接使用其MCP接口集成到交易流水线，或fork项目扩展自定义指标，实现低延迟、高可复现的量化研究环境。
items.summary_en: free-stockdb is a local-first quantitative engine for China A-share daily/minute K-line and ETF minute data. It features incremental sync, local caching, forward/backward adjustment, batch query, backtesting, and indicator computation, all stored locally in SQLite for speed and reliability. Unlike cloud-dependent solutions, it ensures data privacy and offline usability. Ideal for quant researchers and algo traders who need fast, repeatable backtests without network latency. You can fork it, extend with custom indicators, or integrate into your trading pipeline via its MCP interface.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF 是一个拥有350亿参数、专为对话场景优化的AI模型，通过GGUF量化格式压缩，使得大模型能够在普通消费级硬件上高效运行。其核心技术亮点是量化技术，大幅降低显存占用和计算成本，同时保持出色的语言理解能力。实践中，你可以使用llama.cpp等工具在本地部署，构建隐私保护的聊天应用；或者基于它进行微调，开发特定领域的对话系统，无需依赖昂贵的云端GPU资源。这一设计让高性能对话AI真正走向普及。
items.summary_en: Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF is a 35-billion-parameter conversational AI model quantized to GGUF format, enabling efficient inference on consumer hardware. Its key technical innovation is the use of quantization techniques that dramatically reduce memory footprint and computational cost while retaining strong language understanding. You can run it locally with tools like llama.cpp for private chat applications, or fine-tune it for domain-specific dialogue systems without needing expensive cloud GPUs.

items.name: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4
items.summary: Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 是NVIDIA推出的高效混合专家（MoE）语言模型，总参数量高达120B，但每个token仅激活12B，大幅降低推理成本。其核心技术亮点是潜变量MoE与多token预测（MTP），前者让专家选择更灵活，后者通过同时预测多个token提升训练效率和生成质量。模型采用NVFP4精度，在支持低精度计算的GPU上可进一步节省显存。你可以在Transformers库中直接加载使用，适合对话生成、文本续写等场景。若想探索MoE架构的极致效率，不妨用该模型对比传统稠密模型，体验“大参数、小激活”的性价比优势。
items.summary_en: Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 is an efficient mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model by NVIDIA, designed to deliver strong performance while keeping inference costs low by activating only 12B of its 120B total parameters per token. It leverages latent MoE and multi-token prediction (MTP) to improve training and inference efficiency. You can use it with Transformers for conversational AI or text generation tasks, and its NVFP4 precision reduces memory usage on compatible hardware.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。
